tips.text: Equip a spare Secondary such as a Lato or Lex before building the Dual Cestra; it will not start if the Cestras are your only Secondaries.
Rank one Cestra to 30 before the Dual Cestra consumes it; Mastery is earned once per item.
Buy the blueprint, start the build, and farm any missing Gallium on Mars or Uranus while it runs.
Nobody complains about acquiring the Cestra; the only wait is the build timer.
